**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Capture the current commit's gate results**

This canonical command record says every result for the current source is still `PENDING`; the handoff and test-results files likewise record only the rejected `3d78e5c` attempt and explicitly say the corrected source remains unvalidated. Consequently, for commit `430a386` there are no committed exit codes, logs, JUnit results, or independent source review with which the integrator can confirm that the latest HEAD passed its gates. Run the declared checks against this exact commit and commit their results before admitting the reservation.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep review evidence text-diffable**

These entries mark textual Markdown and JSON authorization/review records as `binary`, so the current PR and any later modification suppress their inline Git diff and normal line-based merge behavior. That prevents reviewers from directly auditing changes to the proposal, independent reviews, and recorded results even though Git/Evidence are the required recovery and handoff sources; use a byte-preserving text configuration such as `-text`, if needed, without disabling diffs.
